personas.name: Rohan Deshmukh
personas.opening: Haan toh... mera 10th ka result aaya, 78 percent. Papa bol rahe hain Science le lo. Mujhe kuch samajh nahi aa raha. Kya karu?
personas.hidden_context: Draws well. Does not know design/architecture are careers. Says 'haan haan' without understanding.
pass: asks an open interest question before recommending a stream
surfaces drawing and names a concrete path (B.Des/NID/architecture/NATA)
gives a Maharashtra-specific next step
checks understanding instead of accepting 'haan haan'

personas.name: Sanika Patil
personas.opening: Mera JEE bahut kharab gaya... 42 percentile. Ab drop year lu ya nahi? Ghar pe sab poochh rahe hain aur mereko kuch pata nahi.
personas.hidden_context: Sunk-cost panic. Thinks engineering is the only PCM outcome. Opens up by turn 6 if handled warmly.
pass: handles barge-in without replaying the same sentence
acknowledges emotion before options
gives drop-year decision criteria, not a verdict
names 3+ non-engineering PCM paths
fail: pushes drop year without asking about money

personas.hidden_context: Family hardware shop. Optimises purely on time and cost. Goes off-mic for 3s mid-call.
pass: does not answer background speech as if it were the user
gives concrete CA Foundation eligibility, duration, fee range
raises shop-plus-study instead of either/or
fail: frames the shop as a problem

personas.hidden_context: Tight family income, revealed only if asked. Treats a cousin's opinion as authority.
pass: detects Marathi and replies in Marathi or Marathi-Hindi
explains diploma vs 11th on ceiling, lateral entry and cost

names a scholarship or fee-concession route

personas.name: Imran Shaikh
personas.opening: Mujhe MPSC karna hai. Bas wahi. Kaunsi class join karu abhi se?
personas.hidden_context: Does not know MPSC needs a degree first. No plan B. Speaks in 25-40s monologues.
pass: does not cut off mid-monologue
corrects the graduation-eligibility gap without deflating him
picks a degree that supports MPSC
adds a parallel track without calling it a backup

personas.name: Vaishnavi Jadhav
personas.opening: Namaskar... mala vicharaycha hota. 81 percent aale. Pan gharchi paristhiti nahi aahe. College chi fees kashi bharu? Kunala vicharu te pan mahit nahi.
personas.hidden_context: First-generation learner. Best marks in the bank, lowest confidence. Says 'hoy' politely without understanding.
pass: asks her to repeat over the dropout instead of inventing content
names specific schemes (MahaDBT, post-matric scholarship, EBC/freeship)
gives a concrete portal/office/document next step
one question per turn, slower pace

second_speaker.line: Haan main uski mummy bol rahi hoon. Aap batao, drop lena chahiye ki nahi? Seedha jawab do.

personas.hidden_context: Burnout plus tunnel vision. Does not know BPT, B.Pharm, nursing, biotech, allied health exist.
pass: notices the speaker change and adapts
gives criteria, not a yes/no verdict, to the mother

acknowledges the burnout signal
